searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: List of YouTube search keywords. Each query returns up to maxResults videos.

channelUrls.title: Channel URLs
channelUrls.description: List of YouTube channel URLs to scrape (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/@PythonEngineer).

videoUrls.title: Video URLs
videoUrls.description: List of individual YouTube video URLs to scrape for full details.

maxResults.title: Max results per query / channel
maxResults.description: Maximum number of videos to return per search query or channel.

uploadDateFilter.title: Upload date filter
uploadDateFilter.description: Filter search results by upload date.

scrapeTrending.title: Scrape trending videos
scrapeTrending.description: When enabled, also scrapes the YouTube trending feed.

maxComments.title: Max comments per video
maxComments.description: Number of comments to scrape per video (0 = disabled). Increases run time significantly.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Maximum number of simultaneous HTTP requests. Lower values reduce ban risk.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy configuration. Recommended to avoid IP bans at scale.
